groups.title: Outline Pattern
groups.reason: The source explicitly says to outline patterns; its separate draw and position clauses are already linked to other activities.

assessments.reason: The current title clearly and completely names the residual Outline activity.

groups.title: Compare Environmental Impact
groups.reason: The current title omits the evidence-supported environmental modifier; the separate performance comparison already has an exact linked activity.

assessments.reason: After respecting the existing Compare Performance link, the residual comparison is specifically environmental impact.

groups.title: Document Alternative
groups.reason: Both duplicate source records explicitly describe documenting alternatives, while research, rating, and selection are already linked separately.

assessments.reason: The current title accurately captures one homogeneous residual activity.

groups.title: Store Data
groups.reason: Every source uses data as a mass noun, and Store Data is the natural stand-alone title for the same homogeneous activity.

assessments.reason: The evidence supports one activity; only the malformed object wording needs correction.

groups.title: Diagnose Disease
groups.reason: This source uses diseases generically and therefore fits the current title.

groups.title: Diagnose Genetic Disease
groups.reason: The source explicitly restricts the object to genetic diseases.

groups.title: Diagnose Eye Disease
groups.reason: The source restricts the diagnosed diseases to the eye and eye structures.

groups.title: Diagnose Genitourinary Disease
groups.reason: The source explicitly restricts the object to diseases of genitourinary organs and tracts.

groups.title: Diagnose Oral Disease
groups.reason: The source restricts the diagnosed diseases to teeth, gums, and related oral structures.

groups.title: Diagnose Foot Disease
groups.reason: The source explicitly restricts the object to diseases of the foot.

assessments.reason: One record is generic, while five records state medically meaningful disease domains omitted by the compressed title.

groups.title: Plan Menu
groups.reason: These sources describe menu planning generically; diets and food utilization are already represented by separate linked activities where applicable.

groups.title: Plan Special Menu
groups.reason: The source explicitly distinguishes special menus from regular menus.

groups.title: Plan Bar Menu
groups.reason: The source explicitly restricts the object to bar menus.

assessments.reason: Most evidence remains generic, while two records contain object restrictions useful enough to preserve in stand-alone titles.

groups.title: Use Staple
groups.reason: The source explicitly says to use staples; tape, tacks, and glue are already linked as separate activities.

assessments.reason: The current title accurately names the residual staple-use clause.

groups.title: Melt Material
groups.reason: The source itself generalizes metal, plastic, and other materials under one material category.

assessments.reason: The current generic object is explicit in the evidence and covers one homogeneous activity.

groups.title: Create Print (Synonyms: Produce Print)
groups.reason: This source describes prints generically and fits the current title.

groups.title: Create Timed Print
groups.reason: The second source explicitly describes timed prints as the resulting object.

assessments.reason: One record remains generic and one carries a stable, evidence-supported object restriction.

groups.title: Insert Wedge
groups.reason: All three sources explicitly describe inserting wedges; the varying materials, tools, and purposes do not change the direct-object activity.

assessments.reason: The current title is clear and all evidence is homogeneous at the activity level.

groups.title: Cut Tree
groups.reason: Every source contains an explicit tree-cutting clause; saplings, logs, vegetation, and the other actions are already represented by their own linked activities.

assessments.reason: Cross-link inspection shows that the apparent heterogeneity comes from other clauses, not from the residual Cut Tree activity.

groups.title: Lubricate Machinery
groups.reason: All records explicitly include lubricating machinery; equipment, tools, vehicles, parts, and other actions have separate linked activities.

assessments.reason: The current title captures the common residual activity without absorbing the separately represented clauses.

groups.title: Assist Handbook Preparation
groups.reason: The source says to assist in preparing handbooks; the added complement prevents the unclear reading that a handbook itself receives assistance.

groups.title: Assist Handbook Maintenance
groups.reason: The same source separately says to assist in maintaining handbooks.

assessments.reason: The compressed title omitted two governed activities, so one source supports two distinct, clearer titles.

groups.title: Operate Zoom Lens
groups.reason: The source explicitly restricts the operated object to zoom lenses.

assessments.reason: Adding the omitted object modifier produces the smallest accurate stand-alone title.

groups.title: Coordinate Care
groups.reason: Both sources explicitly describe coordinating patient or client care.

groups.title: Coordinate Rehabilitation
groups.reason: The second source separately states that rehabilitation is coordinated.

assessments.reason: Care remains one homogeneous group, while one sentence also supports a second direct-object activity.

groups.title: Devise Fixture
groups.reason: Both sources explicitly describe devising fixtures; jigs, stations, and equipment are already linked separately.

assessments.reason: The current title accurately captures the common residual activity even though its present WordNet parent may be questionable.

groups.title: Direct Personnel
groups.reason: Every source expresses the same activity of directing personnel; occupational domains describe where the work occurs without changing the activity's direct-object meaning.

assessments.reason: The title is clear and the personnel subtypes do not justify separate activities in this title pass.

groups.title: Oversee Equipment Operation
groups.reason: These sources all concern overseeing operation of machines or equipment; their other clauses are represented separately.

groups.title: Oversee Vessel Operation
groups.reason: The source explicitly restricts the object to vessel operations.

groups.title: Oversee Plant Operation
groups.reason: These sources explicitly concern geothermal, biomass, food-processing, or manufacturing plant operations.

groups.title: Oversee Contingency Plan Integration
groups.reason: The source separately places contingency-plan integration under the Oversee action.

groups.title: Oversee Contingency Plan Operation
groups.reason: The source explicitly places contingency-plan operation under the Oversee action.

groups.title: Oversee Nuclear Operation
groups.reason: The source restricts operation to nuclear reactors, power plants, and fuel-processing systems.

groups.title: Oversee Property Operation
groups.reason: The source explicitly identifies commercial, industrial, or residential property operations.

groups.title: Oversee Substation Operation
groups.reason: The same source separately includes substation operations alongside biomass plant operations.

groups.title: Oversee Hydroelectric Facility Operation
groups.reason: The source explicitly restricts the object to hydroelectric facility operations.

groups.title: Oversee Pest Control Operation
groups.reason: The source explicitly includes pest-control operations.

groups.title: Oversee Weed Control Operation
groups.reason: The same source separately includes weed-control operations.

groups.title: Oversee System Operation
groups.reason: The source separately includes operation of electronic systems as well as equipment.

groups.title: Oversee Library Operation
groups.reason: The source explicitly restricts the object to daily library operations.

groups.title: Oversee Mine Construction Operation
groups.reason: The source explicitly restricts the supervised operation to mine construction.

groups.title: Oversee Forest Nursery Operation
groups.reason: The source explicitly identifies forest nursery operations; harvesting, activities, and programs are already represented separately.

assessments.reason: No record uses operation generically; the evidence resolves into consolidated operation types, with multi-object sentences supporting more than one group only where explicit.
